result: EXCLUDED. The round trip rc -> sps -> rc' is exact at all six rates, so the predicted deficit from rounding is 0.000000; the only residual is +1e-6, a surplus. Integer division in play_start cannot produce the measured 1.6-2.4%.
structural_finding: the device-side instrument is blind to a clock error by construction. The DAC rate is RC dividing MCK/2 and runus counts the same MCK, so a wrong MCK cancels exactly in consumed*512/runus. #48's deficit is therefore NOT a clock error - it is a real loss of conversions against the device's own timer.

clock_ratio_device_over_host.reading: the 0.53% gap is ~16 ms of fixed host start/stop overhead per run, not clock error: it is a constant time and shrinks as the run lengthens. One run length cannot separate slope from intercept; two can.

proposed_next: two-length regression, 3 s and 60 s, no firmware change
